# möbius for macOS 0.2.3

- Fixes a crash when signing in to möbius Cloud with Apple.
- Selected chat text stays readable with the standard translucent highlight in
  light and dark mode, and selections no longer flicker or clear before copying.
- Chat rows keep a consistent highlight width and menu position. Long titles scroll
  on hover, with a static tooltip when Reduce Motion is enabled.
- The chat's Bot pill shows just the Bot's name.
- The installer window shows möbius and Applications side by side with a clearer
  arrow.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later. Works with the same gateway (0.15.53,
protocol 86) as 0.2.0, 0.2.1 and 0.2.2.
